source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps and uses of PCR (PDF 160-162).

items: Denaturation: zyada primers (20 se 30 nucleotides ke silsile) DNA tukre ke saath mila kar taqreeban 98 C tak garam kiye jate hain; double-stranded DNA akele strands mein alag hota hai, har aik in vitro DNA banane ka template.
Primers ki annealing: mehlool taqreeban 60 C tak thanda kiya jata aur forward aur reverse primers akele strands par apne complementary hisson se jurte (hybridize) hain.

Primers ki extension: garmi bardasht Taq polymerase aur chaaron qisam ke nucleotides dale jate hain; enzyme har primer ke 3' sire par nucleotides jor kar baqi tukra replication ki tarah copy karta hai, ab asal tukre ki do copies hain.

Cycle dohrana: qadam 1 se 3 dohraye jate aur do copies chaar ban jati hain. Mazeed polymerase nahi chahiye kyunke garmi ise nuqsan nahi deti. Har cycle aik ya do minute ka hai aur DNA dugna karta hai; 20 cycles ke baad aik tukra million se zyada copies deta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar teen panel. Denaturation taqreeban 98 C: do strands alag. Annealing taqreeban 60 C: chhote hare primers akele strands se jurte. Extension 72 C: Taq polymerase har primer ko naye halke neele strand mein barhata. Neeche: dohraye cycles DNA ko 1 se 2, 4, 8 aur 16 copies tak, aur 20 cycles ke baad 1 million se zyada tak dugna karte hain.
blocks.caption: PCR ka cycle (Figure 20.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: PCR DNA ke tukre ki bohat si copies banata hai. DNA ko 20 se 30 nucleotides ke zyada primers ke saath mila kar taqreeban 98 C tak garam kiya jata hai taa ke strands alag hon. Taqreeban 60 C tak thanda karne par forward aur reverse primers apne complementary hisson se jurte hain. Garam chashme ke bacterium Thermus aquaticus ka garmi bardasht Taq polymerase aur chaaron nucleotides dale jate hain, aur enzyme har primer ko us ke 3' sire se, behtareen 72 C par, barha kar dono strands copy karta hai. Cycle dohrane se, har aik aik ya do minute ka, DNA har baar dugna hota hai aur mazeed enzyme nahi chahiye; 20 cycles ke baad aik tukra million se zyada copies deta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Extension ke liye behtareen darja hararat 72 C hai aur yeh qadam taqreeban aik minute leta hai. Taq polymerase garam chashmon ke bacterium Thermus aquaticus ka garmi bardasht enzyme hai jo ubalne ke qareeb bhi mustahkam aur fa'al rehta hai. PCR genomic libraries banane mein bhi use hota hai, yaani aik jandar ke kul DNA ka majmooa, jo aam taur par DNA sequencing mein kaam aata hai.

items: Muta'addi jaraseem ke genotypes pehchan kar infections ki tashkhees.
Kuch genetic bimariyon aur cancers ki zimmedar mutations ka pata lagana.
Jurm ki tafteesh: sookhe khoon ke nanhe dhabbe ya aik baal ki jarh ke cells se 'DNA fingerprints'.
Chand jhare hue cells ka DNA barha kar bohat shuru ke janeen mein genetic nuqs dhoondna.
Maadoom (extinct) species ka DNA jaanchna, agar thori si miqdar bhi saalim bachi ho.

blocks.prompt: Aik DNA molecule se shuru kar ke 5 PCR cycles ke baad kitni copies hongi?
blocks.explanation: 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 32 copies; 20 cycles ke baad 2 ki power 20, million se zyada.

items: 98 C alag, 60 C primers jurte, 72 C Taq se extension.
Har cycle DNA dugna; 20 cycles million se zyada copies.
Tashkhees, forensics, janeen ki jaanch, maadoom DNA, genomic libraries mein istemal.
